title: Pin Drop Check
summary: Measures a dropped map pin against the typed address and PIN area, so a delivery doesn't go to the wrong door.
description: Map-pin check that measures the pin against the geocoded address and PIN area (ignoring gaps inside GPS accuracy), flags pins in water or on a highway from your geo helper, draws the gap on a to-scale SVG sketch with no map library, and asks "Use pin or address?".
catches: Pin far from the typed address
Pin outside the PIN or postcode area
Pin in water or on a highway (from your classify helper)
Gaps smaller than GPS accuracy are ignored
limits: Needs your geocoder for the address and PIN centre
Surface checks depend on your geo helper
A straight-line distance, not the route
a11y: Sketch is role=img with an aria-label describing the gap
Choice group is labelled and described by the status
Loading and result lines have text; icons are aria-hidden
stops: Delivery sent to the wrong door
